Messages.Body:
The text on some equipment cards say it's a location and not equipment while
in play, but the card text on Heidelburg Castle states clearly that you may
move "Equipment _Cards_" between two ready minions (or is it Vampires?).
Am I right to assume that loquipment may be moved by the use of the castle?
It's still an Equipment card, even tho it's not equipment.

VV

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. It is not an equipment card while in play.
